content: If you miss a dose of this medication, it is essential to contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately to obtain a new dosing schedule. For storage instructions, refer to the product guidelines and consult your pharmacist for specific details. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it has expired or is no longer needed. The information provided here was last updated in May 2024.
